sentences.en: Would you do me the honour of a moonlight stroll?
sentences.zh: 你愿意和我一起夜游吗？

sentences.en: "God bless you!" he cried. "You have saved my honour."
sentences.zh: "愿上帝保佑你！"他喊道，"你救了我的脸面。"

sentences.en: To work for your father was an honour for me.
sentences.zh: 为父亲工作对我来说是一种荣耀。

senses.zh: 荣誉，光荣；尊敬，敬意；荣誉称号；荣誉课程
尊重，给予荣誉；履行（义务），兑现（诺言）
